usageNote: 英式口语常用have got代替have，否定就是haven't got，超日常！下雨天最惨台词👇

examples.en: I have not got an umbrella and it's pouring outside!
examples.zh: 我没带伞，外面正在倾盆大雨！

examples.en: She got completely soaked because she had not got an umbrella.
examples.zh: 她浑身湿透了，因为她没有伞。
